title: Existence of glued invertible module
statement: Let Y be a reduced scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-reduced-scheme] with a finite family of closed immersions i a : Z a → Y [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose underlying images cover Y. Assume each intersection of distinct images is discrete. Let M a be an invertible module on Z a [def-sc-invertible-module]. There is an invertible module N on Y and, for every a, an isomorphism tensorPullback (i a) N ≅ M a [def-pc-module-pullback].

proof.text: Construct the point-indexed open cover, component free frames and common ambient transition units using lem-sc-closed-cover-frame-transitions. This proved construction also gives diagonal units equal to one and shows distinct cover members overlap off the union T of pairwise component intersections.

Restrict each component-frame relation to any smaller ambient open using naturality of the structure-sheaf map. Cancel a free component frame to prove inverse and triple-transition product identities componentwise. When a pair of indices is distinct, the open lies off T, so injectivity of the reduced-cover section map proves the ambient unit identity. When all indices coincide the units are one. The Lean proof handles these cases explicitly.
Apply exists_invertible_of_cech_transition to the cover and the now verified identities. It gives a module N, free frames e, invertibility, and the transition relation e_p = g_pq e_q.

For each component pull back the frames e using the source pullback. IsFreeGenerator.pullback_unit_app proves they are free; pullbackSection_map and pullbackSection_smul transport the transition equations. On the inverse-image open cover both this module and the prescribed module have the same coefficients. The private proved comparison reduces arbitrary linear relations to equality of coefficients by cancellation and applies nonempty_iso_of_isFreeGenerator. All of these source-library frame lemmas are proved.

Use nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction and pullbackPushforwardAdjunction with Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq to identify tensorPullback with the source pullback. Compose the resulting object isomorphism with the comparison just constructed. Return N, its invertibility, and these component isomorphisms; no new sorry is used.

proof_origin.place: Varieties Lemma 09NE, direct existence proof; point-indexed refinement and Lean frame comparisons written by A3, checked against https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09NE

lean.statement:
theorem existsGluedInvertible
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι]
    (Z : ι → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ a : ι, Z a ⟶ Y) [∀ a : ι, IsClosedImmersion (i a)]
    (hcover : (⋃ a : ι, Set.range (i a)) = Set.univ)
    (hdiscrete : ∀ a b : ι, a ≠ b →
      DiscreteTopology ↥(Set.range (i a) ∩ Set.range (i b)))
    (M : ∀ a : ι, (Z a).Modules) [∀ a : ι, (M a).IsInvertible] :
    ∃ N : Y.Modules, N.IsInvertible ∧
      ∀ a : ι, Nonempty ((tensorPullback (i a)).obj N ≅ M a)
